strings.en: This is as far as you go!
Did you think you could escape me?
There's nowhere for you to run!
If you stand in my way, I won't hold back!
I have you in my sights...!
There's only one outcome I want.
I'll corner you... mark my words.
For my new mission...!/　Go, Giganscudo!
A kin of the revived bird of ill omen.../　Do you really think you can stop me?
Your way of fighting is revolting...!
I have no intention of indulging your pleasures!
Jua-Mu, do you think you're a match for me?
It seems you've thrown away your pride, Jua-Mu.
Jua-Mu, obsession alone won't win you this.
I'll be your opponent, Al-Van Ranks!
No matter how formidable a Raftclans may be...!
You're not the only one/　confident in your skills, Fu-Ruu.
Karo-Ran, I won't let things go your way!
Gu-Landon.../　Your grand cause means nothing to us.
You may have what it takes to lead knights,/　but not to rule a people...!
Can a Golaikunru mercenary really match me?
Iradoya, I won't fall for your bait.
The Royal Guard... I wonder how skilled they are.
Gadisword's ace... I welcome this fight.
Vort, I won't let you get in our way!
I'll stain that machine an even deeper red!
The moment you laid hands on the Cross Gate,/　your fate was sealed!
With your death, this battle will come to an end!
It seems you're no mere clown...!
Your looks and your attacks are both in poor taste.
This is no stage for a clown.
So you can even control Zovorg machines.
If it's unmanned, I needn't be choosy about stopping it.
Whatever the machine, a puppet is no match for me.
An evil dragon's fate is to be slain.
Your name suits your body... and I'll shatter it!
Can those wings of yours keep up with me?
Do you have any intention of fighting fair?
The name knight doesn't suit you.
In a way, you're an easy opponent to read.
Let the jet-black darkness sneer.../　I seek only one outcome!
The one who will have to accept/　the fate of destruction is you, XN-L!
I have all the data on that machine...!
Don't think Zovorg mobile weapons/　will work against us forever.
I won't waste time on small fry!
All of you, leave the Earth Sphere!
No matter how many times you interfere...!
I'll put a stop to Golaikunru's schemes.
I won't let you lay a hand on those two units.
Those movements... They're not a Bioroid's, it seems.
White Horn... I'll shoot you down.
If you of Gadisword turn your blades on us...!
For now, I'll bear the humiliation and escape...!
A Cupid is no match for me!
Return to the depths of the earth!
I must eliminate the Lamaris quickly...!
The longer this takes,/　the worse things will get...!
Kaana type or not,/　I'll wipe you out in no time!
I can't let that large Lamaris run free...!
Focus all attacks on the Ida type...!
I can't leave the Lamaris Ida alone...!
However much you change, I'll stop you!
If I can just pin down its movements...!
I won't let you become Dark Brain's vessel!
Targeting me was your last mistake.
I'll make you regret.../　ever laying a hand on me!
It's too early to let your guard down.
Carelessness will be the death of you.
I'm not so naive as to miss that opening.
You think I'll let you escape?
...Ngh!/　To think they'd push me this far...!
Too bad. You were/　so close, too...!
Heavy damage...! But I can still fight!
Wounding my pride/　will cost you dearly!
Ngh...!/　This is not where I'm meant to die...!
Always stay as cool as ice... I still have options!
It's too soon to be sure of victory...!
To push me this far.../　I'll grant that you're impressive, Fu-Ruu.
B-Backed into a corner by a man like that...!
Until I crush your wicked ambitions,/　I cannot fall!
I won't lose to a mere puppet!
I can't let them break through here...!
Ngh...! You're better than I thought...!
Not bad. This is getting interesting.
Ngh!/　But that attack won't work on me anymore!
I'm not one to back down over this...!
Damage like this.../　is nothing I can't handle.
What?! The Siegerlion,/　taking a direct hit...!
That won't be enough to defeat me, Al-Van!
Don't think this is enough to make me flinch, Reggiane.
I can't let that man have the Cross Gate...!
Debudedabide...! I won't let you go any further!
That charging power... It's not to be underestimated...!
XN-L, I won't let you go any further!
I've fought this enemy so many times, and yet...!
As I thought, a Raftclans is not to be taken lightly.
Ngh, it seems it didn't just sprout wings...!
To think Ares Geist could catch me...!
I can't shake off the Yokijin...!
How unlike me... I got careless.
Always stay cool as ice.../　That is Lord Elzam's teaching.
It seems merely touching me/　is the best you can do.
Ngh, I couldn't fully dodge it...!
What?! It caught up to me?!
I'll make up for that mistake right away.
...! To keep up with the Siegerlion's movements...
I'll give you credit for hitting me, Jua-Mu.
Are you testing the waters, Al-Van?
So the title of Knight Commander isn't just for show.
It seems you're not all talk, Gomoudokka.
Is that scythe just for show?
Crystal Dragoon... It's not just for show.
I have to stop XN-L here...!
I have to dodge that blade's tip!
Ngh! It's not just its looks that are strange!
I can't afford to struggle against the Lamaris...!
I didn't mean to underestimate the Lamaris, but...!
Ares Geist.../　It's moving better than before.
Against an enemy that relies only on brute force!
Challenging me with only that much...
Were you really aiming at me?
I'm not one to be taken lightly.
No need to change my evasion pattern.
You can't lay a finger on me.
Do you even know what the word aim means?
It seems you can't/　keep up with the Siegerlion.
This machine is a cut above the Guarlion.
For the Boxer, that was nothing.
For the Exbein Gunner, that's only natural.
I have no intention of indulging your tastes.
Is that all the strength of the leader of the knights?
The battlefield isn't your playground, Gomoudokka.
I have no intention of backing down either, Vort.
Are those wings just for show?
I've seen through you, Skull Knight.
It seems it can't handle its own performance...
If I can keep drawing them in like this...
The Thorn's speed is not to be underestimated.
Even a Raftclans' movements have patterns.
I have no interest in playing with spirits.
I have no interest in frolicking with ghosts.
It's gotten bigger, but its movements are sluggish.
Giant or not, it's still just a Lamaris.
I can use the combat data/　from my last fight with Ares Geist.
Is that the extent of your skill?
Not an opponent worth worrying about.
Next time, you'd do better/　to pick another target.
Do you see the limits/　of your own power now?
This is a waste of time.
What's the matter? Don't hold back.
Now do you understand/　what the Siegerlion can do?
It seems Herluga keeps it close/　for good reason, but...
It seems you can't handle/　the Cross Gate's energy, Herluga.
I wish you'd limit the joke to your looks.
Our world has no need for something like you.
I have to deal with that Lamaris quickly...
Ares Geist... Slow-moving, just as it looks.
I can't afford to take a direct hit.
There's no need to even dodge that.
It seems I have no choice/　but to pull back for now...!
Attacking from out of range.../　You know the basics of combat.
So you've noticed me./　But it's too late.
I won't give you a chance to escape!
This is just to make sure.
A decent bit of suppressing fire, Tasuku.
Oh, very well.../　I'll lend you a hand, Tasuku.
Wait, Tasuku!/　The enemy can still move!
Don't get the wrong idea./　I'm not chasing after you.
Kusuha, leave the rest to me.
Carla, get out of the line of fire!
Ryoto, leave the rest to me.
Yuuki, you take the enemy up front!
Leave this one to me, Raidiese.
Lieutenant, leave the rest to me!
That kid fights just like Tasuku.
Sleigh, leave the rest to me.
Lüne, leave the rest to me.
Rim, leave the rest to me.
Ibis, I'll take it from here.
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll take it from here.
Akemi, leave the rest to me.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I won't let you have your way!
Carla, don't let your eyes wander!
Lieutenant, fall back while you can!
Heh heh.../　What a convenient formation!
Share the same fate, all of you!
I'll break that formation/　wide open!
Looks like you couldn't get away!
This Railgun is a cut above the rest!
This calls for the Blade Railgun!
Can you escape this Continuous Attack?
Don't think you can escape/　the Siegerlion!
Block my path, and death awaits you!
Your misfortune.../　was crossing my path!
Siegerlion.../　true to your name, bring me victory!
Racing across the sky like a gale!
The victor here will be me!
Azure flash! Shatter the wicked shadow!!
This weapon has no blind spots!
No need to be shy.../　take it all!
Even the strongest shield, used right,/　becomes the strongest spear!
If Tasuku can do it,/　there's no way I can't!
This is the end!/　Gigante Unghia!!
You can't escape this Continuous Attack!
You have nowhere left to run!
You can't dodge this Continuous Attack!
Block my path, and death awaits you.
The doom star's blade shows your fate...!
Depart to the realm of ill omen.
With Raptor and Bison working together!
The lion beckons you toward ill fate...!
Don't think you can/　escape my Missiles!
A blow from Space... there's no escape!
I'll show you everything the Boxer has!
I won't give you anywhere to run!
How did you like the power of the ill-omened bird's kin?
Make it ring out, tone-deaf girl.
The ghost is reborn as a phoenix!
You cannot dodge this Continuous Attack!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
You're actually a good singer, right?
To see the twinkle of the evil star is to die!
Sleep beneath a sky lit by the evil star.
My supersonic arrow will pierce you!
All that awaits those in my way is death!
Your fate can no longer be changed!
Can you see through this blade?
If you stand in my way...!
I won't give you a chance to counter!
The flash of light brings you death!
Now, the time has come to prepare yourself!
